## Purpose
Build guidance: the best practices the orchestrator follows when it designs agents and workflows. Distilled items arrive as "proposed" and reach builds only once approved here.

## Responsibilities
- `GuidancePanel`:
- - lists `knowledgeApi.items` with filters (`vocabulary`);
- - bulk status changes with `setStatus` ("N item(s) …");
- - create and update through `ItemEditorDialog`;
- - `remove` ("Deleted").
- `StrengthPill` / `STRENGTH_TONE` show must, should and may.

## Key elements
`GuidancePanel`, `StrengthPill`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.
